# BARCODE-1 Product Barcodes and Label Printing Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:executing-plans. Steps use checkbox syntax. **Starts after QR-1 merges** (it moves the QR page into the shared `codes` page).

**Goal:** Every product and variant gets a valid barcode (auto-generated or merchant-supplied), and merchants print labels from one admin page, "QR codes & barcodes" (`stores/[id]/codes`), with three tabs: QR codes (QR-1), Product labels, Receipt barcode.

**Architecture:** Generation and validation are pure functions in `packages/shared/src/barcode` (EAN-13 in the GS1 in-store range 20-29, check digits, Code128, UPC-A). Allocation is server-side under a per-store advisory lock plus a partial unique index. Label layout, preview, sheet/roll presets, PNG/PDF output and the scan self-check reuse the QR-1 pattern (scene -> renderer -> decode the real pixels before download). The 24 BARKOD shapes and `renderBarcodeSvg` already exist and are reused; the BARKOD credit (`BARCODE_SHAPE_CREDIT`) stays wherever shapes are shown.

**Tech Stack:** existing `@ebda/shared` barcode module, `qr@0.7.2` (QR-1) for the optional store QR on labels, an IN-HOUSE 1D reader (Ruling BARCODE-1a: no new dependency), zod, Express, Prisma.

**Spec:** Ruling BARCODE-1 (register, under QR-1) and the controller's scope message of 2026-10-26.

## Global Constraints

- Gate under the existing feature `inventory.barcode` (`requireFeature` on the API, `useRequireFeature` on the page/tab). Receipt barcode tab keeps its current gating.
- EAN-13 auto codes use prefix 20-29 (GS1 restricted-circulation / in-store range) so they never collide with real retail codes; uniqueness per store.
- Accepted merchant input: EAN-13, UPC-A (stored as typed, normalised to 12 digits), Code128 (printable ASCII, max 48 chars); check digits validated for EAN-13/UPC-A.
- Allocation runs under `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(store_id || ':barcode'))` AND a partial unique index `(store_id, barcode) WHERE barcode IS NOT NULL` on products and on variants (cross-table uniqueness is checked in the allocator under the same lock). Every write path: product create/update, bulk/CSV import, variant create/update, duplicate product.
- Tenant resolver throws on unknown store; zod at the API edge; no orange in Ebda UI defaults; ar + en help/docs in the same PR; BARKOD credit line wherever shapes show.
- Scan self-check: decode the rendered label barcode (shaped bars included) before any PNG/PDF/print.

## Cloudflare-move compatibility (#205 / #229)

The unique indexes change `products` / `product_variants`, which are store-side models in cf-schema; the second PR to merge adds the index to `packages/cf-schema` (generated SQL). Allocation uses an advisory lock today; on StoreDO the DO's single-threaded execution replaces the lock, so the allocator is isolated behind one function (`allocateBarcode(storeId, tx)`).

## Review Focus

- Duplicate codes already in a store when the unique index is added: the migration must detect, report and null the losers deterministically (oldest keeps) instead of failing.
- Two concurrent product creates both asking for an auto code get different codes (lock test).
- A merchant-typed code that is valid but already used by another variant is a 409 naming the owner, never silently reassigned.
- 13-digit input with a wrong check digit, 12-digit UPC-A, leading zeros, spaces and Arabic-Indic digits.
- Shaped bars at a thermal 40x30 mm label: module floor (`meetsModuleFloor`) falls back to plain with a visible note instead of printing an unscannable code.
